items.t: Port Coquitlam real estate market stats

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Birchland Manor?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 6 houses and 1 condos and townhomes listed in Birchland Manor. Those are month-end counts and they move daily, so ask Jared for a current list.

faq.q: Is Birchland Manor a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 17% on only 6 listed, too few to read as a market type. The sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed; on the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers. One month in one community is a small sample, so look at the monthly table above before you decide.

faq.q: How many homes sold in Birchland Manor from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 2 houses and 1 condos and townhomes sold in Birchland Manor over those 4 months; detached houses peaked in August with 1 sold and condos and townhomes peaked in August with 1 sold.

faq.q: How big is Birchland Manor compared with the rest of Port Coquitlam?
faq.a: In September 2026, Birchland Manor held 3.9% of the 153 detached houses listed in Port Coquitlam and 0.4% of the 224 condos and townhomes listed in Port Coquitlam.

faq.q: What mix of houses and condos is for sale in Birchland Manor?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses made up 85.7% of the 7 homes listed in Birchland Manor and condos and townhomes made up 14.3%; of the 1 that sold, houses were 100.0% and condos and townhomes 0.0%.

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in Birchland Manor than in June?
faq.a: Listings of detached houses rose from 5 to 6 (+20.0%) between June 2026 and September 2026.
